title: Spicy Indian Street Corn with Lassi Raita
description: A flavorful and refreshing summer recipe that combines spicy street corn with the coolness of lassi raita. This dish is perfect for a light and satisfying snack or side.
instructions: 1. Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Grill sweetcorn for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently, until lightly charred.
3. In a small bowl, mix together zesty, spicy, garam masala, and salt.
4. Once sweetcorn is cooked, brush with zesty-spicy mixture and season with cumin powder if using.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt, lassi, and a pinch of salt.
6. Serve grilled sweetcorn with lassi raita on the side.
